Canadian work experience becomes the “labour-market integration factor” (duration + points for a high-wage occupation), or, instead, a valid job offer in a high-wage occupation — never both: IRCC keeps the more favourable. No LMIA is required for the job offer any more.
Labour Market Impact Assessment: the former authorisation the employer had to obtain for the job offer to earn points. It has no longer been required for the CRS since {date}.

Educational Credential Assessment (ECA): a certificate from an IRCC-approved body that compares a diploma obtained outside Canada with a Canadian diploma. Without it, a foreign diploma earns no points.
